name: limit-alerts-status
description: Prototype: shows claude-code-limit-alerts usage limits as a plugin status line, without touching statusLine in settings.json.

warn.title: Warning threshold
warn.description: Percent at which the line gets a warning mark.

crit.title: Critical threshold
crit.description: Percent at which the line gets a critical mark.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where usage-monitor-cache.json lives. Empty: UM_STATE_DIR, then ~/.claude/scripts, then the limit-alerts plugin data directory.
